reviews.text: We have been taking Bacon here for many years and we love how she keeps him fresh in the style we like 🥰.

Ami takes such wonderful care of the dogs! I’ve been going here for years and would always recommend it, my girl always looks so cute and happy! The staff here are so lovely and it’s obvious all the dogs are so comfortable and well taken care of. Thank you!

They are the best groomers i have ever been to. I highly recommend this great team, i give them more then a 5 star!. Every time my Bailey went to the groomer she never felt anxiety. She was so calm in the hands of these wonderful groomers. My poor Bailey passed away a few weeks ago. I received a text back about Bailey, i hope one day i will have a chance to return to these wonderful groomers once again. Bailey says thank you from doggie heaven for taking great care of her. She always came home looking so pretty and happy !

There is no alternative. They are the kindest, sweetest, and more reliable people

We love them dearly. As does our pup.

Ami and team are wonderful! I’ve been going to her for many years now and with my second dog now too.
The themed photo shoots and little accessories are just the best!!
Highly recommended!
Have been taking my pup Boba here since she's been a puppy - she is almost 4 now. She loves Ami and her team and is always happy to be dropped here.
Been to many groomers and this place is by far the best! Highly recommend
Great groomers! The staff is friendly & skilled. Our corgi Honey always comes out looking beautiful.

Best grooming service ever! Ami and her team are extremely professional, kind, and responsive. My doodle comes back looking so beautifully and perfectly groomed every single time. I’m never able to trim the fur around her face, ears or paws but Ami somehow manages to do it perfectly and always sends cute photos afterwards. Very quick as well. Will always come back! 😁
Great grooming experience! Ollie looks and smells amazing!
No.1 groomer in the City. Ami always brings out the best in my pup

This is my 5 months old westie. His name is  Louie. He had his very first time grooming and nails clips at Konnichipaw! He looked very happy when I picked him up. They made him look good!
Next visit, a westie haircut! I can't wait! See you soon, Konnicipaw!

I have a pug named Alphonso who regularly comes here for nail trims. They are so fantastic, sweet, and patient and do such an incredible job with him every time. It is always a positive experience. My family, Alphonso and I appreciate all the staff at Konnichipaw! Thank you so much!

My bichonpoo puppy has been going to Konnichipaw Grooming since her first grooming. The team is very friendly and accommodating, and they listen to my concerns and provide suggestions. My pup loves it here. Highly recommended.

Our puppy has been going to Konnichipaw Grooming since his first grooming session when he was 16 weeks old, and the fact that he is always so happy meeting Ami and team every time with his wiggly tail speaks about the wonderful team and the way they treat your furry love. We chose them after speaking to multiple groomers around GTA. Not only is the team responsive in communication, but they also ensure a cage-free environment, vaccination safety, and the best hygiene standards for your baby.
Hands down the best groomer in GTA. Ami, you are the best, and keep doing the good work.
Lots of love and kisses from Toto🐕
Family owned business. Best groomers in the city. Very friendly and kind to my dog. He is excited to get groomed here

We have been going to KonnichiPaw for years. First with our sweet girl Kricket (RIP) and now with our new rescue who is nervous and gets very stressed during grooming sessions. However, with Ami and her team our pup is less stressed and doesn’t act out by trying to mouth and nip during nail trims. They are so gentle, patient  and kind to him and we appreciate them so much for the care they take with our dog. I highly recommend KonnichiPaw for any grooming needs.

Konnichipaw is the Best Dog Groomer Out There!!! Ami and staff are lovely and patient, Mocha loves going and comes back beautifully grommed and really chilled afterwards. Would highly recommend Konnichipaw to everyone!

Fantastic Dog Grooming Experience!

Our puppy Nala loves this place and their ladies. We are so lucky to find them. I recommend Konnichipaw 100%
